label: The Lantern Job
summary: A guild of delvers needs one more pair of hands to fetch a lantern that never goes out. The last crew never came back.
title: The Lantern Job
description: A guild of delvers needs one more pair of hands to recover a lantern that never goes out from the third level of the Underhalls. The last crew to try did not come back.

chapterOutlines.title: The Rope Gate
chapterOutlines.outline: Meet the crew and make the first descent.

chapterOutlines.title: The Fungus Market
chapterOutlines.outline: Trade, bargain or fight with the goblin clans and the lizardfolk traders.

chapterOutlines.title: The Third Level
chapterOutlines.outline: Find the lantern, and whatever guards it.

scene.location: The Rope Gate, the guarded shaft into the Underhalls, at the end of a long night
scene.summary: Torches gutter in the wind rising from below. Your new crew is checking ropes and arguing about who carries the rations.

openThreads: What happened to the last crew?
Why does the guild want the lantern so badly?

npcs.name: Brakka Two-Tusk
npcs.description: An orc delver with a broken tusk, a perfect memory for maps and no patience for heroics.
abilities: Fights like a storm in close quarters

npcs.name: Skritch
npcs.description: A goblin who grew up in the Underhalls and charges by the hour. Claims to know a shortcut to everywhere.
abilities: Knows every goblin clan's password, or says so

npcs.name: Sesh-ka
npcs.description: A lizardfolk trader who sells maps, salt and opinions, and watches the crew with unblinking interest.
goals: Find out what the lantern really does
abilities: Holds their breath for an hour

relationships.label: Crew leader
relationships.status: Willing to give you a chance
